Shared components & rules
rulesRules · new component states (clone badge, sort control, sortable header, device names)
Rules
  1. Choice control by option count: 2–4 segmented · 5–10 dropdown (picker sheet on mobile) · more than 10 searchable.
  2. Clear (✕) only on optional fields that have a value.
  3. Optional boolean is Yes / No / unset. Unset slider shows a dashed track and Set.
  4. Errors appear after the first save, with a summary and Show above the footer. Needed = dashed border plus label.
  5. Mobile: one field per row, touch targets ≥ 44px, list rows ≥ 64px.
  6. Switches: 38×22 on desktop, 44×26 on mobile.
  7. Menus on desktop, action sheets on mobile.
  8. Field status is never shown by colour alone: always an icon or label too.
  9. Fading dividers only between rows inside cards.
  10. Confirm dialogs: the destructive action is secondary on the left; the safe choice is primary on the right. Nothing has undo.
  11. “?” help buttons sit beside non-obvious controls and open a dismissible popover (desktop) or sheet (mobile).
  12. Every ? help button is 44×44 on mobile.
  13. A device shows the name it announces. A nickname you set wins, with the announced name as a muted second line. This device can be named from its row (pencil).
  14. Sort: Created or any field, plus up to 2 Then by keys. Direction is worded per type: Newest / Oldest, A→Z / Z→A, High / Low; single Choice fields sort by option order (Option order / Reverse). Multi-option Choices fields can't be sort keys. If a sort field is deleted, the sort falls back to Created · newest and the header label updates. Phone: tappable label → sheet. Desktop: header control → popover, and sortable column headers.
  15. Cloned records show a Clone badge until you leave the collection, even after the Undo toast is gone. This includes records saved from the Clone editor (record form overflow menu, desktop row menu).
  16. Dictation: Listening and processing cover the whole field. Transcribing has no actions; Cleaning up offers Skip (raw transcript, then a sheet with no version choice).
  17. Every address is ip:port with the sync port (UDP, default 47380).
